body:
I'd been waiting for my friend to get back from Thailand, so when she came home, she could get the DPT out of her mailbox, and try it with me.  She came over around 3 that afternoon, and we divided the dose into 5 piles (100 mg each).  I snorted a line almost immeadiately after we cut it.  She never ended up doing it until later cuz she was too scared.  My eyes started watering cuz it burned, but it was pretty tolerable, and within a minute my limbs felt numb, and I felt kind of dissociated (not anywhere near DXM).  I don't really remember the beginning, except for me doing like 15-20 mg lines every 15 or so minutes. I think I probably did in total about 175 mg, which is a lot, but I started out low just to see what my tolerance was to the tryptamine class.  My room is green and her face looked green, and so did everything else.  My thinking was not really that impaired, just clearer than usual.  I went into my parent's bathroom to take a piss, and I was watching the water in the toilet change colors, and I could see out of the corner of my eye the wall changing patterns.
I was thinking about that 'anything is possible, but if that is true how do I know what is real?'  My toilet water got sucked up into the toilet (I didn't flush), and everything around me turned to stone.  Within a few seconds, everything was normal.  Colors were changing like my walls and stuff, things were morphing into other things.  Smoking a cigarette seems different, foreign, to say the least, like a new experience, and I began to see the big picture, how little I was in the world smoking a cigarette, that me smoking a cigarette had no effect on the world, and all the other people who were smoking cigarettes at that moment.  The funny thing about DPT is the come down, it's not really a gradual drop, it's more of like I  turned around (literally) and one aspect of it was gone.  It was really fun, an interesting experience. Also, there was a strong euphoria that could not be messed up no matter what.  Happy Tripping :-)
